crossRefs.note: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the…
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
translations.bsb: Peter said to Him, “Explain this parable to us.”
translations.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
translations.asv: And Peter answered and said unto him, Declare unto us the parable.
